reason: The README describes a credential-vault plugin whose primary purpose is managing encrypted passwords, tokens, keys, TOTP secrets, imported password-manager records, and browser session cookies; human review is warranted because it can access and export highly sensitive authentication material.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理密码、令牌、密钥、TOTP 信息及浏览器会话数据的凭据保管库插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness credential vault for managing passwords, tokens, keys, TOTP data, and browser session information.

capabilities: Stores encrypted credentials and authentication secrets
Reads and returns full credential records on explicit request
Imports and exports password-manager data and encrypted backups
Captures, stores, and exports browser session cookies
Performs credential health and breach checks using an external service
Deletes, restores, purges, and modifies vault entries
